# miniz

miniz.c, miniz.h and LICENSE are unchanged from the miniz 3.0.2 release:
https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/releases/download/3.0.2/miniz-3.0.2.zip
(SHA-256 ada38db0b703a56d3dd6d57bf84a9c5d664921d870d8fea4db153979fb5332c5).

We write and read the zips of a game's data with it, in the player, the
launcher and the builder (desktop/src-tauri/backup).
